title: Panorama Badewelt St. Johann in Tirol
highlights: Expansive indoor and open-air aquatic complex spanning over 38,000 m²
Sports and leisure pools equipped with a lazy river, turbo slide, and bubble lounges
Extensive sauna village with outdoor whirlpool and tranquil relaxation rooms
Sprawling lawns, beach volleyball court, and pleasant shade from mature trees
kurzbeschreibung: The Panorama Badewelt in St. Johann in Tirol delights visitors with an indoor pool, outdoor pool, giant slides, and a large sauna landscape.
beschreibung:
Versatile Swimming Fun in Any Weather

The Panorama Badewelt in St. Johann in Tirol is one of the largest and most popular leisure and sports pools in the Kitzbüheler Alpen. Featuring more than 38,000 square metres of outdoor grounds and a light-flooded indoor pool complex, it offers top-class aquatic fun all year round.

Action and Relaxation for All Generations

The 25-metre sports pool is ideal for swimming workouts, while the fast-paced giant water slide and children's pool delight young visitors. The sauna world invites guests to regenerate and unwind with various themed saunas, a sanarium, and an open-air plunge pool.
